attributes.name: environment
attributes.purpose: Resolve an environment spec: (EnvModel carrying the installed adapters' product roles (core.environment.product_roles / with_product_roles, attached before the applicable adapters are chosen, so a kit's applies finds its products) with required roles applied, the applicable adapters).

attributes.name: declared_adapters
attributes.purpose: Pure: the adapters that render an environment: its declared stack's (registry order), or those whose applies() matches its data when none is declared; a model without product roles gets the given adapters' first (a kit's applies finds its products by them; the stack check's plain env_model models).

attributes.name: services
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "installed", "type": "Sequence[Adapter]", "required": false}, {"name": "targets", "type": "dict[str, tuple[str]]|None", "required": false, "description": "the render targets chosen in this render (none outside a render)"}]
attributes.purpose: What connectors provide to adapters while rendering (Services), resolved against the installed adapters (their callable logs resolved first: resolved_logs): secret_command, endpoints, listeners, workload_identity, secret_delivery, routes, gateway_plug, ansible_lookup, deployable_config, signals, logs, host_files, render_targets (chosen_for over the targets chosen in this render), mounts_secrets (mounts_secrets_of) and installed_logs (every installed adapter's LogSources).

attributes.name: kit_secrets
attributes.purpose: ((KitSecret, what makes it under the render target, or None), ...) for the Secrets the pods of these components read: None when the record (or the operator) supplies it. With no DS store among them (PRODUCT_COMPONENTS' PingDS components), ds-ssl-keypair is SERVERS_CA. Pure.

attributes.name: components_of
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "m", "type": "EnvModel", "required": true, "description": "carrying the installed adapters' product roles"}, {"name": "w", "type": "Entry ciamWorkload", "required": true}]
attributes.purpose: The ForgeOps components a workload runs as: by its role, a server role of a product ForgeOps deploys (release.PRODUCT_COMPONENTS; the roles the product's adapter declares, core.environment.roles_for in environment m), a DS workload by its name (ds-idrepo, ds-cts); () when ForgeOps doesn't run it. Pure.

attributes.name: unplaced
attributes.purpose: Workloads environment m runs on Kubernetes whose role is a server role of a product ForgeOps deploys (core.environment.roles_for over release.PRODUCT_COMPONENTS) but which it can't place (a DS workload not named ds-idrepo or ds-cts). Pure.

attributes.name: placements
attributes.purpose: Per namespace, the workloads environment m runs with ForgeOps (as which components) and every component that is on (with amster, ds-set-passwords, keystore-create and the platform UIs as they come with them).

attributes.name: image_of
attributes.purpose: The image a ForgeOps component runs: kubernetes kits.kit_image over the component's container names; UNBOUND:forgeops-<component>-image when the record names none. Pure.

attributes.name: ds_servers
attributes.purpose: host:port of a DS store (ds-idrepo or ds-cts): its pods when it runs here (ForgeOps' service names), else the environment's DS service name (PingDS's declared service role, ds-ldaps-service, via core.environment.roles_for: its port, else LDAPS 1636), else UNBOUND:<that role> (UNBOUND:PingDS-service without the PingDS adapter installed). Pure.

attributes.name: pod_labels
attributes.purpose: The labels a component's pods carry: opsdir.io/role (what the kubernetes adapter's network policies select) and the pod labels its cloud's workload identity needs; a component without a workload, the first server role of the product it comes with (release.COMPANION_PRODUCTS, core.environment.roles_for; {} for none). Pure.

attributes.name: image_of
attributes.purpose: The image a ping-devops product runs: kubernetes kits.kit_image over the product's container names (release.PRODUCTS); UNBOUND:ping-devops-<product>-image when the record names none. Pure.

attributes.name: product_values
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "m", "type": "EnvModel", "required": true}, {"name": "services", "type": "Services", "required": true}, {"name": "p", "type": "Placement", "required": true}, {"name": "product", "type": "Product", "description": "release.PRODUCTS entry (name, role, containers)", "required": true}]
attributes.purpose: One product's ping-devops values: enabled, and when a workload runs it its image, container (replicas, resources, Secret env vars), service account, pod labels, pod annotations (kits.workload_marks, plus opsdir.io/derived-containers naming its log sidecars) and storage, envs (the server profile repository it fetches: profile_envs), Secret files, ingress, its log sidecars (product_logs: includeSidecars, out-dir at /opt/out for a Deployment), and its SecretProviderClasses' mounts under csi (secret_mounts), the sidecars' and the classes' volumeMounts combined.

attributes.name: chart_values
attributes.purpose: The chart's values for a placement: the image's EULA setting, DNS_QUERY_LOCATION from the recorded discovery binding, PingFederate admin and engine (product_values), and the shared log sidecars and out-dir volume (log_sidecars.shared_logs).

attributes.name: listeners
attributes.purpose: Adapter.listeners of ForgeOps: kubernetes kits.kit_listeners over its placements and release.POD_PORTS (the release's pods' container ports per server role, on='kubernetes'). Pure.

attributes.name: listeners
attributes.purpose: Adapter.listeners of ping-devops: kubernetes kits.kit_listeners over its placements and release.POD_PORTS (the PingFederate pods' container ports per server role, on='kubernetes'). Pure.

attributes.name: recorded_query
attributes.purpose: The DNS name environment m's PingFederate cluster-discovery binding (discovery_role) has its nodes query when it uses DNS_PING, or None. Pure.

attributes.name: discovery_gap
attributes.purpose: (what to say, the Fix) when environment m's record doesn't have its PingFederate nodes in placement p find each other by DNS_PING through the chart's cluster service (the binding named by discovery_role, PingFederate's declared cluster-discovery role), else None. Pure.

attributes.name: gateway_fronted
attributes.purpose: Whether a cluster gateway in environment m fronts a server role of a product whose service names a chart's Ingresses serve (release.CHART_PRODUCTS, core.environment.roles_for): its Ingresses are then off. Pure.

attributes.name: picked
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "m", "type": "EnvModel", "required": true}, {"name": "services", "type": "Services", "required": true, "description": "installed_logs: every installed adapter's LogSources"}, {"name": "role", "type": "str", "required": true}]
attributes.purpose: ((sidecar container, path under the server root), ...) of a role's PingFederate log files environment m's log routes pick: the kit's own LogSources (kit_logs) and PingFederate's file declarations (sidecar_files), both over Services.installed_logs and m's product roles, in declaration order. Pure.

attributes.name: workload_of
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "p", "type": "Placement", "required": true, "description": "a kit's placement"}, {"name": "name", "type": "str", "required": true, "description": "a component or product name of the kit"}]
attributes.purpose: The workload a kit's placement runs as a component or product name, or None (a component that comes with others). Pure.

attributes.name: kit_image
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "m", "type": "EnvModel", "required": true}, {"name": "p", "type": "Placement", "required": true}, {"name": "name", "type": "str", "required": true, "description": "the component or product"}, {"name": "containers", "type": "tuple[str]", "required": true, "description": "its container names, in the order they are looked for"}, {"name": "kit", "type": "str", "required": true, "description": "the kit's name in the UNBOUND value (forgeops, ping-devops)"}]
attributes.purpose: The image a component or product of a kit's placement runs: the first of its container names the placement's workload bindings record (its own workload's first), else its own workload's only image, else UNBOUND:<kit>-<name>-image. Pure.

attributes.name: kit_listeners
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "placements", "type": "tuple[Placement]", "required": true, "description": "the kit's placements in an environment"}, {"name": "pod_ports", "type": "tuple[tuple]", "required": true, "description": "((server role, port, purpose, peers), ...) the kit's pods listen on"}]
attributes.purpose: A kit's Listeners: the container ports (pod_ports) of the server roles its placements run, declared on='kubernetes' so the kubernetes adapter's network policies admit them to the role's pods and the firewall checks leave them out. Pure.

attributes.name: with_product_roles
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "m", "type": "EnvModel", "required": true}, {"name": "product_roles", "type": "tuple[tuple[str, str, str]]", "required": true, "description": "((product, kind, role), ...): connectors.registry.product_roles of the installed adapters"}]
attributes.purpose: The same environment carrying the roles the installed product adapters declare (EnvModel.product_roles), so kits find a product's roles by product (roles_for). Pure.

attributes.name: roles_for
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "m", "type": "EnvModel", "required": true}, {"name": "product", "type": "str", "required": true, "description": "a product name as an adapter's Adapter.products names it (PingAM, PingDS, ...)"}, {"name": "kind", "type": "str", "required": true, "description": "a contract.ROLE_KINDS value"}]
attributes.purpose: The roles of one kind (contract.ROLE_KINDS: server, keystore, service, cluster-discovery) the installed adapter of a product declares, in declaration order, from the environment's product_roles; () when no installed adapter declares that product. Pure.

attributes.name: product_roles
attributes.purpose: ((product, kind, role), ...): every role the given adapters declare (Adapter.roles), under each product name the declaring adapter lists (Adapter.products), in their order; what connectors.registry.environment and connectors.stack attach to an environment (with_product_roles). Pure.

attributes.name: resolved_logs
attributes.purpose: The adapters with every callable Adapter.logs (a kit's: (installed products' static LogSources) -> LogSources) replaced by what it gives over the others' static LogSources, so ADAPTERS holds static tuples only and every consumer reads them unchanged. Pure.

attributes.name: server_roles
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "product_roles", "type": "tuple[tuple[str, str, str]]", "required": true, "description": "((product, kind, role), ...): core.environment.product_roles of the installed adapters (or an EnvModel's product_roles)"}]
attributes.purpose: PingFederate's server roles, in its adapter's declaration order, from the installed adapters' product roles. Pure.

attributes.name: sidecar_files
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "sources", "type": "tuple[LogSource]", "required": true, "description": "LogSources of the installed adapters"}, {"name": "roles", "type": "tuple[str]", "required": true, "description": "PingFederate's server roles (server_roles)"}]
attributes.purpose: ((server role, sidecar container, path under the server root, declaration), ...): every file PingFederate's servers write, from the installed adapters' LogSources (its own declarations), but those the image's main container streams (TAILED), in declaration order. Pure.

attributes.name: kit_logs
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "sources", "type": "tuple[LogSource]", "required": true, "description": "the installed adapters' static LogSources"}, {"name": "product_roles", "type": "tuple[tuple[str, str, str]]", "required": true, "description": "the installed adapters' product roles"}]
attributes.purpose: ping-devops' Adapter.logs (a callable the registry resolves once: connectors.registry.resolved_logs): each PingFederate server role's main container (server.log and init.log, kind error), then a sidecar per other file its servers write (sidecar_files), all on='kubernetes'. Pure.

attributes.name: discovery_role
attributes.purpose: PingFederate's cluster-discovery binding role (pf-cluster-discovery) as its installed adapter declares it in environment m (core.environment.roles_for), or None. Pure.

attributes.definition_json: {"kind": "typing.NamedTuple (functional form, immutable record)", "fields": {"d": "Directory", "dn": "str", "env": "Entry", "cloud": "Entry", "provider": "str (ciamCloudProvider)", "label": "str cloud/env", "servers": "tuple[Entry]", "bindings": "tuple[Entry]", "unbound": "tuple[str] (required roles not bound)", "stack": "tuple[StackComponent] declared under ou=stack (empty when none)", "declared_roles": "tuple[str]", "overrides": "tuple[Entry] (ciamOverride entries that apply)", "lineage": "tuple[Entry] (the environment, then its bases)", "scope": "Optional[Scope] = None (what a render writes of it: 5.7)", "product_roles": "tuple[(product, kind, role)] = () (the installed adapters' declared roles: with_product_roles; roles_for reads them)"}}
attributes.description: Resolved view of one environment that every renderer works from (roles, not names: R7). Built by env_model(d, spec); a render sets scope (core Scope: environment, keeper, class or bindings) that governance.keepers places by; connectors.registry.environment (and the stack check) attach the installed adapters' product roles (with_product_roles), which the deployment kits find their products' roles by (roles_for, U.14 task 515).
attributes.name: EnvModel

attributes.definition_json: {"kind": "collections.namedtuple (endpoints/prerequisites/collectors/render_targets default (), listeners/proxy_settings/workload_identity/secret_delivery default None)", "fields": {"name": "str", "kind": "provider|platform|product|host|delivery|secret-store|compliance", "applies": "(EnvModel) -> bool | None", "required_roles": "tuple[str]", "render_neutral": "(Directory) -> {path: text} | None", "render_env": "(EnvModel, Services[, targets]) -> {path: text} | None", "checks": "tuple[(PlanContext) -> Findings]", "ref_schemes": "tuple[str]", "secret_schemes": "{scheme: (rest) -> shell command}", "renders": "str|None", "neutral_label": "str|None", "vocabulary": "{vocab attribute: tuple[values]}", "schema": "SchemaFragment|None", "formats": "tuple[(glob, format)]", "products": "tuple[(product, range)]", "secret_patterns": "tuple[SecretPattern]", "importers": "tuple[Importer]", "profile_terms": "Terms|None", "access": "AccessModel|None", "endpoints": "tuple[Endpoint]", "listeners": "(EnvModel) -> Listeners | None", "proxy_settings": "(EnvModel, ProxySettings) -> ProxySettings | None", "prerequisites": "tuple[Prerequisite]", "collectors": "tuple[Collector]", "render_targets": "tuple[(name, what[, False])]", "workload_identity": "(EnvModel, identity binding) -> K8sIdentity | None", "secret_delivery": "{scheme: SecretDelivery} | None"}, "registered_via": "entry points group opsdir.adapters"}
attributes.description: An adapter's declaration (namedtuple): name, kind, applies, renders, checks, schemes, formats, products, importers, endpoints, listeners, collectors, render targets, workload identity, secret delivery, routes, gateway plug, settings, ansible_lookup, signals (5.4), logs (static LogSources, or for a kit a callable (installed adapters' static LogSources, their product roles) -> LogSources that connectors.registry.resolved_logs resolves once at load, U.14 task 515) and host_files (5.4b), places_host_files (5.4b f2, default False): whether it places the other adapters' HostFiles on an environment's servers, version_changes (5.17, default ()): the VersionChanges between its products' releases, read by the planner's upgrade check (connectors.upgrades), reads_back (5.5, default ()): ReadBacks naming which of its importers read which of its rendered files back (round-trip guarantee, connectors.roundtrip), profile / render_profiles (product profiles for the kits), notes (5.4e, default None): (EnvModel, Services) -> RenderNotes (core.notes), renders_synthetic_checks (5.4e, default False), roles_used, mounts_secrets (5.12, default None): (EnvModel, workload) -> bool, whether a deployment kit's pods mount the SecretProviderClasses of a workload it deploys, and roles (U.14 task 515, default ()): ((kind, (role, ...)), ...) the roles its products use by kind (contract.ROLE_KINDS: server, keystore, service, cluster-discovery), which kits find by product (core.environment.roles_for), never by name.
attributes.name: Adapter

attributes.definition_json: {"kind": "typing.NamedTuple", "fields": {"secret_command": "(ref-uri) -> shell command", "endpoints": "tuple[Endpoint]", "listeners": "(EnvModel) -> tuple[Listener]", "workload_identity": "(EnvModel, identity binding Entry) -> K8sIdentity|None", "secret_delivery": "(scheme) -> SecretDelivery|None", "routes": "(EnvModel) -> Routes", "gateway_plug": "(EnvModel, gateway, service) -> GatewayPlug|None", "ansible_lookup": "(EnvModel, ref-uri) -> str|None", "deployable_config": "(EnvModel) -> tuple", "signals": "(EnvModel) -> tuple[Signal]", "logs": "(EnvModel) -> tuple[LogSource]", "host_files": "(EnvModel) -> tuple[HostFile]", "render_targets": "(adapter name) -> tuple[str]", "mounts_secrets": "(EnvModel, workload Entry) -> bool", "installed_logs": "tuple[LogSource] (every installed adapter's, a kit's resolved)"}}
attributes.description: What connectors provide to adapters while rendering: secret_command, endpoints, listeners(m), workload_identity, secret_delivery, routes(m), gateway_plug, ansible_lookup, deployable_config(m), signals(m), logs(m), host_files(m), render_targets(adapter name): the render targets chosen for that adapter in this render (() outside a render), mounts_secrets(m, workload): whether a deployment kit rendering m mounts the workload's SecretProviderClasses (Adapter.mounts_secrets), and installed_logs: every installed adapter's LogSources whether or not it renders the environment (what a kit reads its products' log files from; U.14 task 515).
attributes.name: Services

attributes.description: One namespace of what a deployment kit runs in an environment: namespace, placed ((name, workload), ...: the kit's component or product names and the workloads they run as), on (every name that is on, including parts that come with others such as ForgeOps' companions; () for a kit without such parts). Shared by the kit adapters (ForgeOps, ping-devops).
attributes.name: Placement

attributes.description: Audit 3001, rules (decision note on milestone 68) + 2991. U14-07: Placement(namespace, placed, on=()), workload_of, kit_listeners, kit_image (and applies if it fits) in packages/opsdir-adapter-kubernetes kits.py; forgeops and ping-devops switch. U14-08 option (b), user-approved: product adapters declare their server roles and secret roles in the core contract (opsdir/opsdir/core/contract.py Adapter, a field of declared roles by kind, e.g. server/keystore/service), the registry offers a lookup by product (opsdir/opsdir/connectors/registry.py), and forgeops (release.py KEYSTORE_ROLES, ROLE_COMPONENTS, COMPANION_ROLES, CHART_ROLES; components.py DS_SERVICE_ROLE) and ping-devops (logs.py, discovery.py importing pingfederate) look them up instead of hard-coding or importing; no adapter-to-adapter imports remain (pyproject dependencies dropped where only used for that). The contract field's exact shape is a design choice: escalate it (needs_user) with your proposal before building. Output byte-identical. Boundary: opsdir/opsdir/core/contract.py, opsdir/opsdir/connectors/registry.py (+ tests), packages/opsdir-adapter-kubernetes (kits.py, tests), -forgeops, -ping-devops, and the adapter.py/naming of -pingam, -pingidm, -pinggateway, -pingds, -pingfederate (declarations only), their READMEs/pyprojects.
